),

)

FROM "employment" e

),

)

questions.nlq: Could you tell me the names of people who have worked for companies in recent years, along with the total number of distinct companies they have worked for in recent years, their average tenure at those companies, and rank them by this total count, excluding those who have worked for only one company, and also show how their age compares to the average age of all people in the same nationality group?

meanings.hidden_knowledge: The term recent means within the last year of employment (i.e., Year_working <= 1).
meanings.gt_sql:
WITH recent AS (
    SELECT "People_ID", "Company_ID", "Year_working"
    FROM "employment"
    WHERE "Year_working" <= 1
),
agg AS (
    SELECT 
        "People_ID",
        COUNT(DISTINCT "Company_ID") AS "total_companies",
        AVG("Year_working") AS "avg_tenure"
    FROM recent
    GROUP BY "People_ID"
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "Company_ID") > 1
),
joined AS (
    SELECT 
        p."People_ID",
        p."Name",
        p."Age",
        p."Nationality",
        a."total_companies",
        a."avg_tenure"
    FROM agg a
    JOIN "people" p ON p."People_ID" = a."People_ID"
)
SELECT 
    "Name",
    "total_companies",
    "avg_tenure",
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "total_companies" DESC) AS "company_rank",
    "Age" - AVG("Age") OVER (PARTITION BY "Nationality") AS "age_vs_nationality_avg"
FROM joined
ORDER BY "company_rank";
